walkthrough: Goal: colour a shape and shade it without painting outside it, darken the shading by Multiply, keep the figure's layers together so they hide and fade as one, move a layer into the group, take a step back, and find it all again after reopening.

Entry: on an empty library (2880 x 1800, landscape) choose a blue in the colour panel, make the brush larger with the side bar's size slider and paint a solid blue shape on Layer 1 with the pen. Tap Layers: every row now ends with its blend mode's letter (N for Normal) before its eye. The header holds New group (a folder) beside the plus. Under the rows, for the highlighted layer: Opacity, the four blend modes Normal, Multiply, Screen and Overlay in two columns (Normal outlined), Alpha Lock, Clipping Mask, move up, move down, Group and delete.

Clipping: tap the plus (Layer 2 above Layer 1), then Clipping Mask: Layer 2's row slides one step to the right and shows a small arrow bending down to Layer 1, its base. Tap Multiply: Multiply is outlined and the row's letter says M. Choose red and paint across the blue shape and past both its sides: red shows only on the blue, darkened by it (Multiply); beside the shape nothing is painted.

Group: open Layers, tap Group: a row Group 3 with a folder's chevron and an eye appears above the two layers, which slide right under it. The footer now also shows Group 3 with its opacity and a Group opacity slider; Group reads Ungroup.

Hide and fade: tap the group's eye: the whole figure disappears; tap it again: it is back. Drag Group opacity to about 40 %: the figure fades as one picture, the darkened red no more see-through than the blue under it.
Collapse: tap the Group 3 row: its chevron turns and its two rows slide up into it; tap it again: they come back. Collapsing is no step.
Undo in the side bar: the group is fully opaque again (one step for the whole slider touch); redo: faded again.

New group: tap the folder in the header: Group 5 with an empty Layer 4 appears on top, Layer 4 highlighted. Tap move down (since S38: hold Layer 4's row and drag it up a row): Layer 4 steps out of Group 5, which goes with its last layer; tap move down again (since S38: drag it down a row): Layer 4 joins Group 3 as its top layer and slides right into it.
Reopen after the system closed the app: the same layers, group, clipping, blend modes and opacity, pixel for pixel; every group open; the panel closed.

Failure and cancel: Group is grey when the layer under lies in a group (groups are one level deep); move up and move down are grey at the stack's ends outside a group; a fill or a transform on a layer of a hidden group refuses with the notice for hidden layers; each change is one undo step. Not here: groups in groups, a group's own blend mode, dragging rows, merging, renaming, layer masks (S24).
